node.title: Conic evaluation gives kernel degrees two through four and exact collision heights
node.statement: In odd characteristic a primitive pencil-free operator3 carrier with conic evaluation image has original-field binary-product normal form and kernel-image degree chi2,3 or4. In the double-conic case the kernel map is an isomorphism with a degree2 base divisor; rank-one invariant planes have at most one other nonbase exceptional fibre. Actual non-eigen collision lines have original primitive height nu=D/2. No general conic census or source payment is claimed.
